answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the cedar of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the forge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
